description: This file implements the core logic for warning reporting control, including configuration classes, a singleton proxy class for managing warning reporting, and functions for handling warning categories, bounds, and exclusions within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategoryConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for warning reporting bounds and category settings, including report and warning bounds and category-specific configuration.

classes.name: ExcludedCategoriesValuesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for excluded categories, including callsigns and modules to be excluded from warning reports.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class managing warning reporting, including category management, bounds configuration, and exclusions.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::WarningReportingUnitProxy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the warning reporting proxy, including lock and handler setup.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the warning reporting proxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event to the current handler.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the warning reporting list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the warning reporting list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Handle
methods.description: Sets the handler for warning reporting and processes any pending categories.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FillBoundsConfig
methods.description: Fills bounds configuration parameters from a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FillExcludedWarnings
methods.description: Fills excluded warnings list from a JSON string.
